tha-ap330:1.1: Sumanāveḷiya.] Vessabhussa bhagavato lokajeṭṭhassa tādino / sabbe janā samāgamma mahāpūjaṃ karonti te. // //
tha-ap330:2.1: Sudhāya piṇḍaṃ katvāna āveḷaṃ sumanāy' ahaṃ / sīhāsanassa purato abhiropes' ahan tadā. // //
tha-ap330:3.1: Sabbe janā samāgamma pekkhanti puppham uttamaṃ / ken' idaṃ pūjitaṃ pupphaṃ Buddhaseṭṭhassa tādino? // //
tha-ap330:4.1: Tena cittappasādena Nimmānam upapajj' ahaṃ / anubhosiṃ sakaṃ kammaṃ pubbe sukatam attano. // //
tha-ap330:5.1: Yaṃ yaṃ yonūpapajjāmi devattam atha mānusaṃ / sabbesānaṃ piyo homi pupphapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap330:6.1: Nābhijānāmi kāyena vācāya uda cetasā / saṃyatāna tapassīnaṃ katam uṭṭhāhitaṃ mayā.
tha-ap330:8.1: Ito *ekādase kappe* Sahassāro' si khattiyo / sattaratanasampanno cakkavattī mahabbalo. // //
tha-ap330:10.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Sumanāveḷiyo thero i. g. a-ti.
